ROOT_CAUSE: vision.py answered the building-upgrade control with a constant identity -- {"id": "STOREHOUSE", "level": 26, "target_level": 27} -- and none of those three values was ever read from a frame. They came from dataset/raw/live_build_warehouse_upgrade_dialog.png, and that dialog does not even show the current level: the only level on it is the PREREQUISITE row 大熔炉 等级 27. So the identity was reverse-engineered from the frame's filename/context, which is exactly what the operator forbade. A second constant lived on the construction-timer branch (queue_building STOREHOUSE, from_level 26, target_level 27) copied from the frame that template was cropped from. Neither had a live attempt, so nothing working was lost -- what was lost was the ability to look correct without reading anything.
